    Dogecoin vs Shiba Inu (DOGE vs SHIB)

    DOGE vs SHIB: what the numbers show

    Dogecoin's market cap of about $9.87B is 4.4 times Shiba Inu's ($2.22B); they rank #11 and #25 of the 114 coins tracked here. Over the past year Dogecoin fell 60.5% and Shiba Inu fell 53.7%, a gap of 6.8 percentage points in Shiba Inu's favour. Dogecoin was the more volatile of the two over the last 30 days (65% annualized against 58.7%). Within the year, Dogecoin's largest fall between daily closes was 64.9% and Shiba Inu's was 61.4%. On November 22, 2026 Dogecoin was 64.2% below its 52-week high and Shiba Inu 61.1% below its own. In 5 of the last 12 complete months, Dogecoin did better than Shiba Inu. Measured against Bitcoin's daily moves over 90 days, Dogecoin had a correlation of 0.86 and Shiba Inu 0.79.
